analyst.text: New Orleans are in turmoil: Dejounte Murray requested a trade through Klutch Sports, posted (and partly deleted) 'THE SABOTAGE IS REAL', and the club has confirmed it will explore deals, all during a six-game losing streak that included a 51-point loss to Golden State. The Warriors are without Stephen Curry (torn oblique) but have found sparks, and New Orleans native LJ Cryer gets a homecoming game. The news angle leans clearly towards Golden State.
